description: This is a Python source file that defines functions and classes for interacting with GitHub sponsors data via GraphQL, processing sponsor information, updating a YAML file, and automating Git operations for pull requests.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor entity with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents sponsorship tier information including name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Models a sponsorship node with sponsor entity and tier information.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Models an edge in the sponsorship graph with cursor and node.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainer
classes.description: Represents the list of sponsorship edges for a user.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user and their sponsorships as maintainer.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Defines the top-level data structure in the GraphQL sponsors response.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: Defines the overall GraphQL response structure wrapping the data.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Loads configuration from environment or secrets, including tokens and repository info.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL query to GitHub API and returns the parsed JSON data, raising errors on failure.

methods.name: list[SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge] get_graphql_sponsor_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Fetches sponsor edges for a user, handling pagination.

methods.name: defaultdict[float,dict[str,SponsorEntity]] get_individual_sponsors( settings: Settings, )
methods.description: Aggregates sponsors by tiers into a dictionary mapping price to sponsor entities.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Updates a YAML content file if the content has changed.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Orchestrates the process: fetching sponsors, updating YAML, and creating a PR on GitHub.
